feature.title: Session Zod schema for agent sessions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC1: SessionSchema validates all session fields
acceptance_criteria.details: Complete Zod schema with id, featureId, status, timestamps

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC2: Reuses existing ID schemas via import
acceptance_criteria.details: Imports FeatureIdSchema, SessionIdSchema from existing modules

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC3: Status enum with valid transitions
acceptance_criteria.details: SESSION_STATUS enum: pending, running, completed, failed

discoveries.discovery: Schema composition via imports keeps types DRY and consistent
discoveries.lesson: Import existing ID schemas rather than redefining branded types
discoveries.code_pattern:
import { FeatureIdSchema } from './feature';
const SessionSchema = z.object({ featureId: FeatureIdSchema });

what_worked: Fast implementation (14 min) by reusing existing patterns

new_patterns.name: SCHEMA_COMPOSITION_PATTERN
new_patterns.description: Compose schemas by importing existing ID schemas
